arms.D1_routed_mskcc3: H2 with the 3-class MSKCC head -- descriptive, not deployable (label space is an archive-curation artifact)
arms.H1_pooled_head: one head on all train rows
arms.H3_oracle_routed: H2 heads, true archive (diagnostic: router cost H3 - H2)

components.eligibility: own head only if every class has >= 20 train images in the domain, else the pooled head
components.gate: research.selective.mahalanobis (tied, Ledoit-Wolf), 7 classes, fit on train; threshold = held-out in-scope 0.95 quantile
components.heads: L2 multinomial logistic, standardised, balanced, C by held-out Macro-F1 of the head's own domain (pooled: all held-out rows); HAM = checkpoint layer
components.router: L2 multinomial logistic over (ham, bcn20000, mskcc), balanced, C by held-out log loss

design_rule: stage 3 = H2 if (H2 - H1 Macro-F1) >= 0 and its CI lower > -0.005; otherwise stage 3 = H1 and the router is a provenance / drift signal only
deviations: runbook lists head training as a GPU step; the heads are logistic regressions on cached features and are fit on CPU -- same model class, exact solver
HAM train features are in-sample for the trunk; they enter the pooled head and the gate fit
MSKCC routes to the pooled head (eligibility rule); its own 3-class head is D1 only
evaluation: manifest_v4 split=reserved (4,733 images, 0 HAM, 104 under-40 escalating lesions); features re-extracted with the deployed transform; read once, receipt results/v4/s58/reserved_receipt.json
fit_split: manifest_v4 split=train (HAM 6,981 in-sample for the trunk; BCN 6,704 and MSKCC 1,609 out-of-sample)
holm_family: escalation-mass pAUC@0.2 McClish H2 - H0 (<40 rows, bootstrap over that band's groups -- S51/S54 convention)
not_done: no calibration, lambda or abstention: S59 composes those
ood_probe: PAD-UFES-20, all 2,106 images, same transform (not sealed; S8b scored it)

primary_endpoint.interval: lesion-grouped (group_id) paired percentile bootstrap, 2000 draws, seed 42

references_descriptive: deployed V1 ensemble (S54 frozen reserved probabilities)
V4 pooled control R0 seeds 42/43/44 _last (S54 predictions)
selection_split: manifest_v4 split in {val, ham_val} (BCN 1,853, MSKCC 417, HAM 1,532)
stage_reports: gate: reserved false-reject rate (overall, escalating, per band), PAD reject rate, AUROC reserved-vs-PAD and ham_val-vs-PAD
router: reserved accuracy overall / per archive / within nv and mel
head: marginals per arm, per archive, per band; H2 - H0 on the gate-accepted subset (descriptive)
title: Domain router + domain-matched head (three-stage front end)
trunk: ml/checkpoints/convnext_tiny_best.HAM-only.pt frozen, penultimate features, 224 px, 1 view, deployed eval transform (bilinear 256 -> crop 224)
